name: http-log
description: Logs the session's HTTP calls (WebFetch) in a table of url and response code

timeRanges.title: Time ranges
timeRanges.description: The periods the HTTP calls pane can limit the table to, comma separated: a number and s, m, h or d (minutes when there is no unit). For example 10m,30m,1h

retention.title: Keep calls for
retention.description: How long a logged call is kept before it is cleaned from the list and the store: a number and s, m, h or d (minutes when there is no unit). For example 1h or 30m. A period longer than this shows nothing older than it.
